new_value: Two fixes in lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c + support: (1) lichen_checkin_due() now guards the clock step-back (last_checkin_at > now returns false before any subtraction), signed-safe like rollcall_prune_expired; no more spurious immediate due on wraparound. Header doc updated. (2) PAYLOAD_MAX relation enforced: new public macro LICHEN_CHECKIN_ENTRY_CBOR_MAX (306 B, breakdown in checkin.h) and a file-scope BUILD_ASSERT in checkin_resource.c (MAX_CHECKINS x 306 + wrapper <= CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN_PAYLOAD_MAX); Kconfig help now states the enforced relation. The assert fired for one in-tree config - the checkin_resource twister suite (MAX_CHECKINS=8, PAYLOAD_MAX=1024): PAYLOAD_MAX resized 1024 -> 2560 (sane: multiple of 512, headroom over required 2464) and said so here per instructions. Kconfig defaults (16x306+16=4912 <= 5120) compile unchanged. Evidence: host suite 18/18 under ASan/UBSan incl. new regressions test_due_clock_step_back (900s step-back not due; boundary 10899/10900) and test_maximal_entry_within_bound (pins the 306 B macro to the encoder, protecting the assert premise); twister lichen/tests/checkin_resource on qemu_x86/atom: 1/1 configurations, 8/8 test cases PASS with the assert in the build, and a negative control with PAYLOAD_MAX=1024 correctly fails the build with the assert message (proves the guard is live). Note: twister WITH -x ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<repo>/lichen fails at Kconfig parse (zcbor dependency loop) identically with my changes stashed - pre-existing 4.1.0/v3.7.0 workspace split, filed as its own bead (discovered-from this one). cppcheck/clang-tidy finding profile identical to baseline (no compile db artifacts only). Also filed: roll-call-list PAYLOAD_MAX bound (same class, discovered-from).
